video_title: Allen Graves | Post Game vs Washington Wizards | November 18, 2026

quotes.speaker: Allen Graves
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Graves on his growing comfort and role within the team
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I'm getting more comfortable out there, just understanding my role with this team.
quotes.quote: I feel like I'm getting more comfortable out there, just understanding my role with this team needs and just trying to make winning plays. I feel like they're entrusting me with a lot, especially as a rookie being able to be in the rotation and being able to get a chance to play each and every night. So, just figuring it out as I'm going, getting more comfortable playing on the ball, playing off the ball, getting crashing, getting offensive rebounds, and then defensively as well. I'm learning how to guard pin-downs, guard screens, things like that, just being able to adjust in the game and they're entrusting me and just instilling a lot of confidence in me throughout this whole process. So, I feel like as each game goes on, I'm just getting better and better and understanding it more.
quotes.social_post: Allen Graves says he is feeling more comfortable in his rookie role and is focused on making winning plays while learning to play both on and off the ball.

structured.context: Allen Graves discusses his development and comfort level within the team rotation during his rookie season.

quotes.speaker: Allen Graves
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Graves on the championship mentality of the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: You could tell they were a championship team, just them being able to when they make mistakes.
quotes.quote: You could tell they were a championship team, just them being able to when they make mistakes, just getting right back to it, next play mentality. I feel like that's something we're growing in and just continuing to build, and then just their to stick to what they do, no matter if it's going good, bad, they're going to stick to what they do and run it with execution. And I feel like that's the biggest part, and then obviously they have a lot of good pieces on their team.
quotes.social_post: Allen Graves on the Knicks: You can tell they are a championship team because of their next play mentality and their ability to stick to their execution regardless of how the game is going.

structured.context: Allen Graves reflects on the championship mentality and execution displayed by the New York Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Allen Graves
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Graves on the team's motto and staying together through adversity
quotes.excerpt: Got to pull together in these times because that's the only way we going to get out.
quotes.quote: Got to pull together in these times because that's the only way we going to get out. You know our motto every time we see it on the board when we're walking over is 'stronger together'. So, really taking emphasis to that and pulling together throughout this time because we don't, we got each other. That's the only we are family, and just trying to pull together so that we can get out of this and I feel like that's the only way.
quotes.social_post: Allen Graves says the Raptors are leaning into their motto stronger together to help the team navigate their current struggles.

structured.context: Allen Graves speaks about the importance of team unity and the Raptors motto during a difficult stretch of the season.

quotes.speaker: Allen Graves
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Graves on studying film and learning from Scottie Barnes
quotes.excerpt: Scottie is an amazing offensive rebounder just his physical physicality on it.
quotes.quote: Obviously watching film, Scottie is an amazing offensive rebounder just his physical physicality on it. I feel like he puts himself in the right position in order to be able to grab the rebounds. So, just trying to study that and then obviously learning how people shoot. Yeah, just trying to figure out who shoots what way, you know if they back rim more, front rim, just trying to figure that out and put myself in the best position to where I can get a hand on it or or grab the offensive rebound.
quotes.social_post: Allen Graves says he is studying Scottie Barnes to improve his offensive rebounding and is learning to track how different players shoot to better position himself for boards.

structured.context: Allen Graves explains how he studies film and learns from Scottie Barnes to improve his offensive rebounding.

quotes.speaker: Allen Graves
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Graves on the importance of game experience over film study
quotes.excerpt: It definitely comes to a film, you have to study film, but as far as being in the game.
quotes.quote: It definitely comes to a film, you have to study film, but as far as being in the game, that's the best experience you could get. I feel like for me, I studied a lot of film coming into this season, but the more I'm in the game, the more I'm able to go out there, make mistakes, and learn from them. That's the best way to really grow, but obviously the film aspect of it limits my mistakes, so just trying to make sure that you know when I'm out there, I'm giving the team my best effort, but I feel like it's just about work ethic, drive. I feel like that part of it comes only in the game.
quotes.social_post: Allen Graves says while film study is important, the best way for a rookie to grow is by getting on the floor and learning from mistakes in real game situations.

structured.context: Allen Graves compares the value of film study versus actual game experience for his professional growth.
